step_by_step_reasoning:
The whiteboard shows two primary architecture tracks originating from mobile users (UserConsumerMobile):
1. Upper flow (Web & Fraud filtering / Analytics): Mobile app traffic enters via AWS WAF, which forwards clean traffic to EC2 web instances. EC2 sends suspicious activity rules back to WAF. Separately, RDS user/transaction data is pushed via Data Pipeline to Athena for gamified post-analysis.
2. Lower flow (Instant Payments): Mobile API requests enter API Gateway, triggering Lambda functions, which write transaction status results into DynamoDB.
